description: Generate unique IDs: UUID v4 (random), v7 (time-ordered, monotonic within a batch), v5 (deterministic from namespace + name), ULID, nanoid (custom size / alphabet), KSUID and MongoDB ObjectId, up to 100 at once. Or inspect an existing ID: detects UUID (version, variant, embedded v1 / v6 / v7 time), ULID, KSUID, ObjectId and Snowflake (Twitter / Discord) and decodes the timestamp. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/id-generate

namespace.description: uuid5: dns | url | oid | x500 or a UUID
